role: CI gate (ci.yml thread-sanitizer job when inputs.scope != 'gates'; make thread-sanitizer) that runs the EmuquTests unit target under Thread Sanitizer and fails on any TSan warning or test failure.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; sources lib/preflight.sh (no cd to repo root; relies on cwd). DESTINATION defaults to select_simulator_destination.sh output ('id=<udid>'). gate_mktemp log (exit on failure). Runs `xcodebuild test -enableThreadSanitizer YES -only-testing:EmuquTests` into the log with set +e. Counts 'WARNING: ThreadSanitizer', "' passed", "' failed" lines. races>0 -> prints 20 lines after each warning, exit 1. status != 0: if failed>0 prints first 20 failed lines; else greps build-error markers and tails the log; exits with xcodebuild's status. Else appends summary. Header comment is stale: it says the app is 'in Swift 5 language mode' with '45 @unchecked Sendable / nonisolated(unsafe) escapes', while check_strict_concurrency_enabled.sh enforces SWIFT_VERSION = 6.0 in all 8 configurations and the actual escape count/budget is 14.

flags.text: Header claims Swift 5 language mode and 45 unchecked escapes; the project is Swift 6.0 in all configs (enforced by check_strict_concurrency_enabled.sh) and .ci/unchecked_sendable_budget.txt is 14 with 14 real hits.

In the build-failure path, `grep -E ... | head -40 >&2` under `set -e -o pipefail` aborts the script with grep's status 1 when no marker line matches, so the promised 'last 40 lines of the xcodebuild log' are never printed and the exit code becomes 1 instead of xcodebuild's status.
